property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer returns true even if the underlying transferFrom calls fail (it ignores the low-level call results).
For a non-empty recipient list, C.transfer never reverts and never changes its own Ether balance.
For a single-recipient list, C.transfer returns true regardless of whether the underlying token transferFrom succeeds, and it always completes without reverting.
C.transfer always reverts when the recipient list is empty, for any addresses and value.
